testcase.name: writing about a task the row cites is shown under that task's name
entries are ordered by kind, then task, then excerpt
attach decorates only the derived field
attach on no evidence is no evidence
the same sentence from two different tools is two entries
the same sentence saved twice with different spacing is listed once
a blank excerpt is not writing
the hidden count never goes negative
a limit below one is refused rather than silently showing nothing
the list is capped while the total still counts everything
evidence that has never been attached carries an empty set, not null
an explicit limit is honoured and the total ignores it
writing about a task the row does not cite is left out
every tool kind can be attached
attach gives each row only its own tasks' writing
a row with no sources has no related writing even when writing exists
the order does not depend on the order the records arrive in
